defs.def: an infectious disease like a very bad cold, that causes fever, pains and weakness 流行性感冒；流感

ex.s: After a serious flu outbreak wipes out 99.4% of the world's population, a battle unfolds between good and evil among those let.
ex.t: 一场严重的流感消灭了全球99.4%的人口后，在幸存者中展开了一场善与恶的战斗。

ex.s: Doctors battle new disease Doctors are flying to an island off the coast of West Africa after an outbreak of a new disease caused by a flu virus.
ex.t: 医生与新疾病作斗争 在一种由流感病毒引起的新型疾病爆发后，医生们正飞往西非海岸附近的一个岛屿。

ex.s: You see my new job’s a hassle and the kids have the flu, But it’s sure nice talking to you, Dad.
ex.t: 你看，我的新工作很麻烦，孩子们得了流感，但能和你聊聊真好，爸爸。

ex.s: Most worrying, though, I got the flu easily and experienced many toothaches, too.
ex.t: 不过最令人担心的是我很容易得流感，也经历了许多牙痛。

ex.s: I no longer suffer from a flu virus or toothaches either.
ex.t: 我也不再患流感病毒或牙痛了。

ex.s: So a very rare disease will have a low baseline and just a fewcases of it in one place will be classified as an epidemic; as opposed to more common diseases, such as the flu, that have a higher baseline.
ex.t: 因此，一种非常罕见的疾病的基线很低，在一个地方出现几个病例就会被归类为流行病；而像流感这样更常见的疾病则有更高的基线。
